assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished replacement Baraat Prasthan (wedding party departure) BUS illustration for an Indian wedding invitation. Image 1 is the original BUS scene and peach/coral-gold palette reference. Image 2 is a reference for the refined painted invitation-art style and ivory-gold groom's clothing. The bus must be the main subject: a beautiful, realistic, well-proportioned single-deck ivory wedding coach, seen in a clear three-quarter view with its front toward the lower right. Show the ENTIRE bus with all its body and wheels inside the canvas. Decorate it tastefully with pink, cream and marigold flowers and blush ribbons; keep the windows and vehicle structure believable and clearly readable. A groom in ivory-gold sherwani with a peach turban stands on the ground near its passenger door, with two family members wishing him well and one dhol musician celebrating nearby. Family passengers may be subtly visible seated through a few windows. All people must be on the ground or seated inside; NO people standing on the roof. No bride, no horse, no car. Graceful Indian wedding departure mood, warm late-afternoon lighting, detailed elegant florals, soft painted illustration style that matches a pastel traditional invitation. Use a balanced tightly fitted near-square composition: the bus and small family group fill about 90 percent of the canvas, with small even transparent margins and no large unused top area. Genuine transparent background around the complete scene, natural clean alpha edges, no rectangular peach backdrop. Keep foreground flowers restrained so the bus remains prominent. No text, letters, numbers, route signs, logos, vehicle brands, dates, labels or watermarks. Decorative wedding illustration, not a real booking or venue photograph. Return only the full illustration, not a card or mockup.
